name: Wild Boar (Druid Wild Boar mod): the HD farm pig reshaped into a great wild boar as a shapeshift form
notes: Donor: the Act 1/3 town critter `pig` (65 bones, clips neutral, walk, fidget_01, fidget_02 only), so every other clip is authored here. Skeleton: +Y up, +Z forward (snout at z 4.2), +X the boar's left. Rotations about model axes: +X pitches the nose down (and a leg's foot backward), +Y turns the head to the boar's left, +Z rolls it onto its right side. jaw_bind_jnt opens the mouth with +X.

Shape (bind-pose model units): heavier, higher forequarters with a bristle crest from the neck to the middle of the back, a leaner belly and narrower rump, a longer wedge-shaped head with a tapering snout, small upright ears, thinner legs. Bones are not moved by a reshape, so props on bones are placed against the reshaped mesh (dev\body_workbench.py tusks writes the attach entries).
Tusks: the bonewall's curved bone tusk (`fx_mesh_bone_tusk`, seen rendering as a prop on the Quill Bear on 2026-11-13) on jaw_bind_jnt at both mouth corners, rising and curling back and out.
retexture: the pig albedo recoloured dark brown-grey at a path of the same length.
Clips: neutral and walk are the stock ones (the pig stands and walks on the ground at the right height). Everything else is authored from a held neutral pose ("at": 0) or the walk.
modelIndexIncludes: QuillRatDruid's and DruidGiantRaven's models are carried in this mod's model index (install this mod after both; rebuild the index when either changes its models).
